title: Premier Classic London Private Half Day Tour
description: An excellent choice for first-time visitors, this tour takes you around the city in a classic London black cab. Visit notable sites and landmarks such as Buckingham Palace, Piccadilly Circus, London Bridge, the London Eye, Tower of London, and much more as your local guide shares interesting stories and history at each locale. You can also choose to attend a Changing of the Guard ceremony.

reviews.usertext: We had a wonderful tour of London and learned so much about the history of this town. Highlights were that we hit many of the must-see spots and toured the Guild Hall which really brought Old City London to life for us. Our tour guide was Paula, and she really made the city come alive for us. The tour was booked for 45 hours but Pula provided a tour closer to 5 hours and left us off at a great pub for lunch.

We had booked a half day tour in London for my fiancé's birthday during our long weekend there. It was his first time in London and I am SO glad we did this tour. Paul was our driver and we had booked on a Sunday morning starting at 8am. This ended up being such an amazing time to do this tour because the traffic was very light on Sunday morning and it allowed us to see SO much of the city. We saw the Mayfair pub, walked around the Tower of London and even managed to see the changing of the Guards. It was perfectly planned and timed out and Paul, was the most amazing tour guide we could have asked for!

I would recommend anyone to do this tour it is an amazing crash course into London and British history! Paul was SO knowledgeable and was the perfect guide!

On our 1st full day in London we booked a 4 hour private tour. We were lucky enough to have Lawrence as our tour guide and saw all of the important things that we wanted to see. Lawrence was absolutely the best Tour Guide!! He great knowledge of London and its history, took pictures for us and made this experience absolutely amazing for us! I would highly recommend Heritage Black Cab tours, hopefully you will be lucky enough to have Lawerence show you around the city!

Antony loves London and his passion for the city really made our tour special. The Black cab tour is the best way for a small group to see the highlights of the city. Antony is very personable and funny and we would highly recommend him to anyone interested in this tour. We saw some great parts of the city that we would never have found on our own. He knew where to go for the best view of the changing of the guard which was a sight to see. His enthusiasm for London makes us want to return very soon.

The private cab tour was a great way to see and learn the history of many of London's highlights in a way that would not be easily possible on one's own. Our guide, Graham Perry, was personable, accommodating, and very knowledgeable about the city and enthusiastically shared several stories and "fun facts' about the attractions we visited. In addition to the popular tourist sights, Graham took us to some not so well known ones that were very uniquely British and very interesting to learn about. My family especially appreciated the opportunity to drive through and get a sampling of the many different London neighborhoods. I would highly recommend both this tour, especially for first-time visitors to London, and Graham!

Our tour guide,Dave, connected with us several times prior to our tour to confirm the appointment. He arrived early and was very eager to tweak the tour to our preferences and interests. Since this is our first visit to London we encouraged Dave use his expertise and guide us through the highlights of the city. He did a wonderful job of narrating the tour and sharing his extensive historical knowledge along the route. Dave stopped many times to allow us the opportunity to take photographs. He was a friendly guide who encouraged questions and conversation. We would rate this tour one of our most memorable and we generally book at least one or more tours in each city we visit. To get a comprehensive overview of London consider taking the Heritage Cab tour. And thank you Dave for an enjoyable day!

Antony was a gem, witty and courteous, and loaded with lots of interesting tidbits of London lore. He was also responsive to our requests, and we got to see a lot in a short amount of time. It was a first trip to London for 3 out of 4 of us, and we were so happy we booked this tour. Highly recommend!

Hi, this is Marcy & Mark Perry.
We had a wonderful time with our tour guideTracey
McKenzie. She was pleasant, kind, & full of great historical information. Her passion for history & explaining the different sites made the tour
exciting to us.l would recommend her to anyone.
Thank you, Marcy & Mark Perry
From: San Francisco, Ca.

We had a great day with Moses as our tour guide. He was incredibly knowledgeable and friendly. We were able to see many different attractions throughout the city and get some insider knowledge from Moses. We would definitely recommend this half day tour!

Great day with Greg showing us the sights of London! The cab was spotless and our guide was very professional and knowledgeable about the city. We really enjoyed learning so much about the history of London and being able to see things you probably don’t get to see on larger tours. Would highly recommend this company and our tour guide Greg !

We had a wonderful experience with Black Cab Tours on our very short stay in London. Brian was a wealth of knowledge, he knew so many things about London that only a long time Londoner with a passion for his city’s history and culture would know. He tailor made our tour for us, taking into account things like special interests, mobility issues, etc. I knew we needed to make the most of our limited time in London, Brian made every minute count.

Laurence was a wealth of information! He took us all over the city and shared so much about the history, architecture, and fun facts of London. He also took photos of us to document our adventures. Thanks for a great experience!

Tony was an excellent guide for our family’s first trip to London. He enthusiastically showed us the highlights with history and fun facts along the way. Tony did an excellent job of navigating the crowds and helping us secure the best viewing spots. And he took lots of photos! His love of London and the history was evident. We really enjoyed our day and only wish we had more time to sightsee. We will probably book a full day on our next visit. Thanks Black Cab and Tony for a great first experience in London!

Our private tour guide was Dave C and we was terrific. We are a family of 5 and have 3 boys (ages 20, 18, 14). We planned this half day tour to give us a good lay of the land in London as well as teach us all about the city. Dave was punctual (a little early, in fact) and was the perfect guide. He catered the tour to what our interests were and was so knowledgeable about London and it's history. He was also a super nice, funny, friendly and accomodating guy. We hopped out at certain sights and he took pictures of us when we requested. He had great recommendations for lunch (The George Pub was awesome!) and we all felt just a bit smarter and more "in the know" on all things London after our 4 hour ride with him. I highly recommend this company as they were very communicative before and after the trip.

We had a long layover and booked the Black Cab Heritage Tours in order to see the highlights of London in a limited time. Chris was our driver guide. He was very knowledgeable of the sites that we visited and shared many interesting tidbits. Prior to the tour, Chris checked on our expectation for the tour and confirmed the meeting details. On the day of the tour, he arrived prepared and on-time (which is very important in my book). Best of all, he presented the tour in such a manner that we felt like we were on an outing with a friend! We are now looking forward to booking Chris for more tours next time we visit London.

We had only three days to spend in London and having never been before, we wanted an overview of the highlights of the city. Our guide and driver, Graham, delivered that and more. He was engaging, beyond knowledgeable and sensitive to our needs and agenda. We talked history, ancient and recent, architecture and food. He turned us on to his favorite fish and chips place which did not disappoint. The cab was large inside and very comfortable. I'd highly recommend this treat to others.

I’ll start off by saying that if there were more stars, Rob and Mark would be very deserving. We recently traveled to London with our son and his wife along with our 2 year old granddaughter. We had an overnight flight and wasn’t sure what our energy level (especially our granddaughter) would be on our first day in London. We decided on a Black Cab tour to get acquainted with the city. Doing so with Black Cab Heritage tours was absolutely one of the best choices we made during our stay. Rob was quick, courteous and beyond accommodating from the first contact. But then it got even better. Our driver, Mark, met us at the doorstep of our flat on time with a meticulous black cab (Mercedes minivan per our request) with our requested child safety seat in place. (Mark assured us that his wife saw to it that it was installed properly!). Our granddaughter had fallen asleep in the flat so our daughter-in-law stayed behind for the first hour. Mark immediately suggested that he could start the tour route in a manner that would get us back to the flat so that they could join back up with us in an hour. Mark knew where and how to get to all the places you want to see on your first visit to London and he does it with a wealth of knowledge and humor! A couple of the highlights included a stop and photo op at Buckingham Palace and an elevator ride to a rooftop that ’s one of the highest points in the city with an incredible view (a location only a local would know). Mark had stocked his cab with water and SPECIAL snacks for our granddaughter. It’s honestly difficult to find the right words to give Mark (and Rob) the compliments they deserve. To top it all off…we had asked to be dropped off at a Pub for dinner and planned to get an Uber back to our flat. But that didn’t happen….Mark insisted on coming back to the pub when we were done so that we wouldn’t have to get an Uber with our granddaughter! We ended our day feeling like we had spent the day with a good friend. Thank you Mark!

Moses definitely made our trip to London memorable and fascinating. My mom and wife could not stop praising him for his professionalism, humour and knowledge of this beautiful city. It was an utmost pleasure to have spent a couple of hours with Moses whilst touring London. I would definitely recommend this tour to friends and other visitors. Once again, thank you for the wonderful experience.

Can’t believe it’s been 1 year since our trip to London and our black cab tour. We have such wonderful memories of our tour with Moses. This was our first trip to London, and this was such a great way to see the city. We enjoyed being able to get out and walk through sections of the city with Moses sharing history and facts and guiding us to places we would not have known about on our own. Highly recommend and would definitely book another tour if we we’re in London.

We had THE BEST TIME!!!! My wife and our friend had never been to London. I had been multiple times and literally felt that I was competent to “show them around”… Until we met Will-our taxi tour guide. He knew SO MUCH! It was unbelievable… I kept smacking my head I was so blown away by his knowledge. He stood up to a constant stream of questions from all of us with a never ending smile and a deep sense of pride for this wonderful country. If your looking to do something unique and special for yourself and the people you love-this is the best way to do it! A real highlight of an already memorable trip!

To start, Russell was entertaining and extremely knowledgeable. He has been driving a cab in London for over 30 years! As we drove along the streets to a different location he would point out smaller tidbits of information. We fully feel we have experienced London, and we started our tour before even checking into our room. I love English history and feel so much more educated. He'd park and take us into a pub or Kensington Palace grounds. He even drove us to get authentic fish and chips. This tour was well worth the money and time spent in our short 2.5 day trip in town. Highly recommend!

My husband and two boys were delighted to experience London in a Black Cab with our tour guide Dave! The car was clean, comfortable and full of amenities. Before we could even ask for anything, Dave anticipated everything we needed. We were able to see so much in a single day tour. It was our first time in London so we were able to get a handle on the City so we could take deeper dives later in the week. Dave was also able to curate the experience based on what interested us most. He knew we loved history, Harry Potter, music and the royals and he planned our day so we experienced every single one. We went inside venues that we would never have access to as regular tourists and were the only people in certain locations getting a private tour. It was very premium and seeing London in a Black Cab made it far more special than any other experience we could have selected. We can't wait to book another visit!

I couldn’t imagine a better experience learning about the London! Antony was not only extremely knowledgeable about the history and culture of London but also made us feel like old friends from the start.He’s a talented story teller who kept us captivated for over 4 straight hours. My sons actually said they were sad for the tour to end. A bonus was his spotless taxi and courteousness. We will definitely keep in touch and hope for the opportunity to see Antony again.

Very professional, adapted fully to our needs. Very knowledgable with a balanced approach. Spoke English slowly to help us understand as we are not native speakers. The cab is very well equipped with air conditioning and fan. Strongly recommended

We had the Premier Classic London Tour, which was a 4 hours city tour of London, on 31 December 2019.

Thank you very much Paul Williams, for giving us the most enjoyable and wonderful city tour we ever had. We enjoyed the trip thoroughly, and it was a very well presented and informative tour, with plenty of stops for photos. Paul even offered to become our photographer during the tour (he offered us the minute the tour started).

We have been to London 6 years ago, and we wanted to recreate some of our photos in 2013. Paul went to great length to make this happen. He took our pictures to the right angle so they would look similar with the pictures we took 6 years ago. Very nice and kind of him. We really appreciate that.

We had a great day with Paul. We highly recommend this tour and hope to return to do it again !!

My friends and I were in London celebrating a big birthday and booked this company for a private sightseeing tour and it was money well spent as they gave us the most amazing insight to London. We booked the half day sightseeing tour. Our driver, Chris, was so informative and easy company that the time flew by. If I’m back in London again, I will definitely book another tour with this company. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!

Our tour guide Will was fantastic. He was kind, polite, funny, and so informative. Will explained the historical significance of each attraction which brought the tour to life. We attended the changing of the guard, and Will insured each member of our family had a viewing spot and was safe in the crowd. We had a wonderful tour experience and we thank Will and hope to see him on our next trip to the great city of London.

We used black cab heritage tours twice. The first time was for transport from the airport to Eunoch station. Our driver was Barry and he was excellent. Took us off the beaten path to show us some sights on our way. He was knowledgable and funny. We then used black heritage cab later in our vacation for a full day tour of the city with Bill. I can not recommend this tour enough. We were able to see all of the highlights of London and Bill was so knowledgable about every site. He gave us so much history everywhere we went and had a great sense of humor too. The tour was supposed to end at 3 but Bill continued the tour till 4:30 because we had not seen all the sights he wanted to show us. He then dropped us off at the tube station near where we were going to watch a football match instead of taking us back to the hotel. Book this tour...you will not regret it.

Dennis was prompt, courteous and very knowledgeable. I highly recommend him as a tour guide. The tour took us to various places of interest and Dennis not only had pertinent information but little known facts about each location.

My husband, son and myself were first time visitors. We had a fabulous experience and learned so much about London history. This tour is perfect if you’re new to London and want to spend a half day visiting the top spots. Our guide is named Lawrence O’Toole and if possible, request him for sure!! He is so knowledgeable and funny, just a lovely person. We feel so fortunate to have met him!!

We spent a fantastic afternoon with Stella! We had a limited amount of time in London and she made sure we saw EVERYTHING on our list. Stella is a wealth of information and was able to provide the historical background on every spot we toured, she even took a picture of us in front of each attraction. She really went above and beyond to make sure we had the perfect tour.

We enjoyed an extremely interesting, informative tour of many scenic and historic sites around Central London. Dave (our driver/tour guide) was superb in providing humorous color commentary for all the amazing sites we visited. His depth of historical knowledge was impressive 👏 👏 !
We definitely recommend this tour for first time visitors to London.

We had a fantastic day upon arrival in London. Our guide took us to all the major spots and catered the tour to what we wanted to see (for me, the Bank of England). Our guide had tons of history and insight to share with us. We thoroughly enjoyed it and highly recommend.

Our tour with Barry Ivens was lovely today! He was very knowledgeable on all things London. He was flexible and so very kind. My son is a fan of Harry Potter he even showed us some cool spots from the movie. We took so many pictures we will always treasure and he gave us so much information so we could easily decide which sites we wanted to go back and spend more time touring. Highly recommend Barry with Black Cab Heritage Tours! So energetic and just has a “let’s make it happen” kind of attitude! Thank you for a wonderful first day in London!

Kelly Cox

We appreciated the tour which was fantastic.John, our tour guide, was GREAT! He took us all around London, including walks to historic merchants and vistas that we probably would not have seen otherwise. Meeting shop owners was a plus. John went out of his way to accommodate our every need, just had to ask.We felt like family! I believe we are actually cousins! Thank you, John!

We had a wonderful 4 hour Premiere Tour with Mark M. on Boxing Day. Mark took us all over London and we were able to see all the big sites plus a few more, as well as get some great family pictures while doing so (thanks to Mark). Mark is a great guide - gave tons of interesting information all through the tour, engaged my teenage and young adult children, provided tips for us during our stay in London, was flexible and accommodating to different interests (Beatles fan, Harry Potter fans, etc) and was very good company. It was a great kickoff to our time in London and we are very glad that we chose Black Cab Heritage Tours.

My wife and I recently engaged this tour and were lucky enough to get Paul Murphy as our guide. He was a great guy and this was the best way to see the highlights of London. He picked us up in the black cab and we were off on a great tour. We came to find out that Paul offers all kinds of different tours depending on your interests and was able to adjust our tour on the fly when we told him some of our interests (Rock music and Bond films). If you book Paul I really suggest you look at his webpage to understand all the knowledge of London he has. His list of qualifications and accreditations he has is quite impressive and a testament to just how seriously he takes his position...but at the same time he was just a really cool guy. It was a fantastic 4 hours that flew by. A great way to see London. Check him out: Paulslondon.com
This guy was AWESOME

This tour was a Christmas present from our granddaughter who leaves in London.
It was our first time visiting and could not be a better experience!
We were very lucky that Mark Moretón was our guide, he was wonderful!
Not only knowledgeable, pleasant, informative and patient. He stopped as many times we wanted to take pictures or enjoy a special view of the place. Gave us hints for when we come back to visit by ourselves.
The Cab was clean, very comfortable to get in and out and with great visibility.
I highly recommend it!

When I made a booking it was daunting what kind of service I was going to receive. Our chauffeur (Dennis) gave us a 5 star service. He is a fantastic tour guide. If you want to know London in a day, he is the guy to hang around with

Amazing! This tour is worth every penny. It's a great way to see a lot in a short time period and the knowledge shared by the driver is second to none. Our driver was Dennis and it was truly a wonderful experience.

What an amazing experience! We had a 12 hour layover in London. It was overnight, but black cab heritage tours still went out of their way. Our driver was Graham. He had an amazing amount of knowledge. It seemed like he knew literally everything about London’s history. He even catered our tour to us. He showed us a plaque that was dedicated to Texas. He also told us that they fly the Texas flag in London on the Fourth of July. He took us for some of the best fish and chips in London. We not only were able to see the sites, but we were also able to learn the amazing histories behind them. We are also both big fans of Harry Potter. Graham had a lot of knowledge of the movies and filming locations. We drove around London in the wee hours of the night. We were amazed at the amount of history, and the amount of things we were able to see in our short time there. Graham picked us up from the airport around 8pm, and dropped us off at 3 am. It was truly an amazing experience! The company went absolutely above and beyond. We are so thankful to Graham and Rob! When we return to England we will most definitely turn to them for tours.

Spending the day with our guide, Lawrence, was excellent! We wish we would have scheduled a second day with him, he gave us so much insight into the City. We were up close and personal for Changing of the Guards. Our tour around the City left us feeling we had accomplished so much in such a short time. Thank you Lawrence!

Mark is the best tour guide ever! I brought my daughter to London for her 13th birthday and we saw all of the sites in a 3 hour tour. Mark even waited for us while we rode the London eye. What a fabulous experience. So safe for a girls' weekend. We will book again!

I haven’t been back to London in 5-10 years. Karen gave an amazing overview of London with enough history and fun facts. She was patient and was extremely fun to hang out with for 3-4 hours. I would highly recommend this tour to anyone and pick Karen!

What a fun day! Our driver Antony was passionate and knowledgeable about London. He was very excited to share his hometown with us and had a great itinerary planned. We went to the better known sites like Buckingham Palace but also some off the beaten path locations that only a local would know about. He kept us engaged and entertained. Highly recommend!!

Our family of five did two tours with this company, the half day London and the full day of the Cotswolds. Mark and Moses made sure we had so much fun! They were knowledgeable, flexible and personable. We also booked our transfers to and from our hotel with the

Our day started with Dave meeting us at the hotel. He spent some time with us to understand our interests, what we may have seen previously and our expectations for the day. Dave was fabulous! The knowledge and expertise required to drive a cab in London is impressive enough without providing a wealth of historical facts along the way. Dave shone in both areas. The tour was the perfect kickoff to our stay in London. Highly recommend booking a tour and ask for Dave! You will not be disappointed.

This was the best choice we made on our trip!! Our Driver, Will Jones, was fantastic!! We saw sights we never would have seen on our own, places and pieces of history that we would never have known to even look for! He was entertaining and so knowledgeable, full of interesting facts. We were there right before the National Day of Remembrance, so a lot of the normal streets and paths were blocked off, but he was still able to get around all of that and allow us to see all the great sights around London. He even recommended a great fish & chips place where he dropped us off at the end of the tour. Fantastic! Highly recommend! Worth every penny!

Lawrence picked us up at our hotel on time. He was organized and we spent 4 very enjoyable hours touring London. Saw everything we asked and also so much more. Was informative and courteous. Couldn’t have a better guide!

Experience was amazing. Had seen multiple times in the past but our driver and guide made this a true one of a kind experience. His local knowledge and professionalism made it worth every penny. Would highly recommend.

This tour was absolutely wonderful. Our driver Brian was outstanding and so accommodating. He really made our trip. We had some other things that we wanted to see and he happily included them. When we met we were strangers and when we parted we were friends. Brian is so knowledgeable. Brian and this tour made our trip. Do not hesitate to book this and request Brian. He was the BEST!
There were 3 of us….myself, my husband and our 30 year old daughter. We all agreed that this was the best decision of our trip!

We scheduled a half day tour for our first day in London, which was a great way to keep us awake after a red-eye. Tony was our guide and he couldn’t have been a better host. He gave us an overview of London and drove us to many different sights, but we also got out and walked around. That led to places we would not have seen on our own or as part of a larger tour. The tour company was very easy to communicate with and Tony went above and beyond to customize the trip based on our interests. Highly recommend!

SAM was amazing!!! kept the conversation going the entire time without effort. he knew so many historical facts and made it fun! we learned so much more with Sam than we ever could if we were just to walk in/past the landmarks. highly recommend - it will leave you wanting to do it again!

Booking was an easy process and Stella arrived right on time. She was a wealth of knowledge and made it so comfortable. I am on crutches due to an ankle injury and she helped make my experience so enjoyable and not as if I was a burden. She was a lovely lady and her tour went above and beyond our expectations!! Thank you Stella!!!

This tour was a highlight of our trip. Steve Dinero was absolutely amazing!!! He showed us things we would never have seen on our own. His knowledge was outstanding and he really went the extra mile to show us the things that we were interested in. We laughed so much! He was the best tour guide ever! Loved it!!!!!!

My husband and I were in London for a concert and wanted to do a tour before going back to Paris. We took the four hour tour with Paul. It could not have been any better. It gave us the overview of London that we were looking for. Paul was helpful with the history too. He picked us up at the train station and dropped us off at our hotel. Highly recommend!!

Great experience! Hit all the highlights and a few hidden gems! Learned so much history in a fun and informative fashion. Will, our guide was incredibly knowledgeable, interesting, and funny. He was even able to keep my teenager engaged! Highly recommend!

We had a great time. Dennis was fantastic. The cab was clean and comfortable. Dennis was very good and had a great attitude. He had snacks and drinks ready for us and took great pictures. I highly recommend this tour. At the end, he took us to our dinner reservation! Perfect time

Antony was an awesome guide who is knowledgeable, entertaining, and accommodating. During the tour, we acquired a thorough snapshot of London’s key historical sights, while learning interesting tidbits about each landmark. Thank you for a wonderful experience!

Wonderful time! Dave our guide was excellent. He text on arrival at our Hotel, about 20 min early, which was great for us. Taxi was very clean, and all electric. We discussed where we would like to go and what we would like to see. Dave was very knowledgeable and was happy to answer our tourist questions all along the way. Lots of photo opportunities, and rest stops as needed. Favorites were the stops at the lesser known sites. I would highly recommend them for your private London tour.

We arrived in London and needed something fun to fill our first afternoon to keep ourselves from going to sleep. We got that and so much more. Craig picked us up at our hotel and gave us a wonderful driving tour of the city. We stopped at multiple sites and then he gave us history of things that we had never heard. Highly recommend this as a way to get a general overview and to learn a little bit more about someone’s personal experience being a Londoner.

We had the absolute pleasure of taking a 3 hour trip around London with the wonderful Bill Berry - What a great guy.
There seemed to be nothing that Bill didn’t know, his knowledge of London & his wonderful stories were simply magnificent, we could have toured with Bill for days such was our interest & enthusiasm for all of his wonderful information.
Dealing via email with Rob was professional & with no hard sell just absolute professionalism at all times.
This was the highlight of our visit to London & Many Thanks for all your help in making this possible.
Kind Regards
Nuala Burns & Family
Adelaide Australia

My family and I were able to fully customize our tour with Driver Guide Mark Taylor. Mark was knowledgable and flexible. This was an outstanding service as it was flexible for pick-up, drop-off and included the highlights we valued most.

We booked a Black Cab tour on one of our first days in London to get a big picture look at the city and take notes for places to go back to, with tips for visiting the sights. Our guide Dave was very thoughtful and attentive. (Even with our son who had to make a few bathroom stops along the way - which would have been tougher to accommodate on a larger tour!) He was very good about asking about our interests and making tweaks to the tour to ensure we had the experience we wanted. Riding in a black cab is such a quintessential London experience and this was a great way to make sure we did it. The ride was comfortable with many easy scheduling options. (I did an afternoon tour, realizing we'd be jet lagged and likely sleeping in a little on our first day.) We really enjoyed spending the day with Dave and were sorry to say goodbye at the end. Highly recommend!

Had a very nice tour with Graham. He is a very nice gentleman - friendly, solicitous and very knowledgeable. On the day of our tour there was a big biking event and many of the streets were blocked off. We weren't able to get through to see many of the major sites (e.g. Tower of London), but Graham showed us everything he could and took us to several interesting places we wouldn't have been able to see otherwise. Well worth the investment.

We had an amazing experience with the 4 hour Premier Classic London Tour! Mark picked us up from our Airbnb and then we got started. We got to see everything we wanted, including Buckingham Palace, The Shard, the Financial District, the Tower of London, Soho, Picadilly Circus, and so many more sights. He was really flexible and took us to other places we wanted (like Jack the Ripper's museum, which we just took a quick look at); he also gave us a fantastic map which we kept throughout our stay. He was also really entertaining and well-mannered and told us about the history of London as we cruised through. Would definitely call him again if we're back in London!

Communication with this company was clear and concise, we were picked up on time and proceeded to spend an incredible half day with Mark. Our 14 year old granddaughter experiencing her first London visit and enjoyed it tremendously. Mark is an excellent tour guide, very personable and went out of his way to provide an amazing tour as were were on a very limited schedule. We did not feel rushed and the time was maximized for the optimum experience.

We had a phenomenal time with Craig from Black Cab Heritage tours. From the set up with Rob, all communication was easy and smooth and very easy to schedule. Once our day started, Craig was prompt, if not early, and we were on our way for a fabulous day exploring London. He took time to get to know what each of us were interested in, and then geared his tour to accommodate us. He took us all over London with lots of fun tidbits. We saw Westminster Abby, Buckingham Palace and changing of the guard, St Paul’s Cathedral, and lots of other things as well as some fun extras like the Kingsman suit shop (from the movie the Kingsman) as well as Lobb & Co where they make amazing hand crafted shoes, as well as a cigar place that had the famous chair where Churchill was pictured and where he tried his cigars. Huge huge deal to my hubs that LOVES Churchill!
I would HIGHLY recommend this tour and Craig to get the overview and highlights of London! So much better than a tour of 50+ people!
Thank you Craig for such a great day and taking care of us AND keeping our 9 year old excited and engaged for the entire tour!!!

This was our second trip to London. On the first, we did the hop on/hop off bus. This time we wanted something different. This was a great experience. Our driver was very knowledgeable. He took us by all the major sites but then we saw a few out of the way places too...places where the “average” person would live/hang out. We got out at a couple of sites to take pictures and he even walked us around a few areas which was a nice break from being in a car most of the day. He gave us excellent recommendations of places to eat in certain areas. Great experience for sure!!

I bought this tour for my parents as a gift.. they absolutely loved everything about it!! From the driver to the tour and details given at all the sites!! They said " we would never have seen London like this without this tour !" Defiantly worth it and would recommend!!

graham perry was excellent he and his fellows made the london trip for us
the queens death made everything hectic but he compensated beautifully

if in london choose graham and premier BCHT
We really enjoyed Greg Smith as our guide. He was on time, friendly and very knowledgeable. I would definitely recommend this tour to anyone who would like to get a comfortable tour around London.

As a writer, I travel all the time. However, for my father's first trip to London, I wanted to pick something that captured a bit of the visitor spirit without being too touristy. I had previously taken one of these tours, and enjoyed it, so I thought to book it again. Man, am I glad I did. Mark Moreton was my driver, and let me break down why this is the ONLY tourism experience I will say is an unmissable one in London. Everyone should take this tour.

1) It's bespoke, and that says it all. Having taken two of these now, I can happily confirm that they were different, and not different as in variable. Mark took on our experiences and interests and used his impressive knowledge of this vast city to show us things that were deeply interesting and personal. My dad was a first time visitor, but my husband was Camden Town-born and they both saw things they'd never seen before. When Mark said he'd have enjoyed the conversation anyhow, I was chuffed because I did too. I'd hang out and cruise the city any day with him, because it was an absolute joy.

2) It's professional and easy on people with somewhat limited mobility. My husband had a stroke, and as such is not able to do long walking tours and standing engagements. This is not a problem on this tour. By considering your interests and needs, my husband was able to enjoy himself without feeling as though he was holding anyone up or leaving anything out. He had a brilliant time. Mark even gave us a few extra moments in the beginning so we could finish our breakfast at the Regency Cafe. He was a true gentleman, through and through.

3) These drivers know this city. If you are new to England or London, you should know that all black cab drivers have to pass something known as, "The Knowledge."
Ask one about it sometime, it is an achievement. These guides not only have that knowledge under their belt, but they are city guides as well! This is not a rote, routine speech, but a nuanced reflection of a complex, historic and modern place told by someone who gets it. By simply listening, you'll get it in a much more real way than by just knowing the facts and dates.

4) Are you on Instagram? Like photos? Take the opportunity to capitalize on the cab's ability to use special spots, lanes, and set down to get more than the obvious tourist shot. Stand out - your guide will help you here.

As you can tell, I loved this experience. I've done it twice, with two different family members new to the city and I would without a blink do it again. Go hit the big deals: see the museums, have a Sunday lunch, but if you only do *one* tour in this magnificent city - this is the one no one should miss.

Absolutely loved our day out, I had planned an event for 30 people - classic London treasure hunt in black cabs. I did not hear one negative review - Sam, Rob and Mark (sorry I don't know the other names) were absolutely incredible. Would love to do it again and yes I 100% recommend!!!!

My son and I really wanted to see London as neither one of us have ever visited this magnificent city. We had 15 hours layover; however, it was from about 8 p.m. till 11 a.m. the following morning. We decided to start our tour at 3 a.m. with its completion at 9 a.m. It worked out PERFECTLY!

We did a bit of shopping at the terminal as stores started to close shortly after we arrived. Very important – make sure to exit the airport – go through customs/passport control before it is closed for the night. We had coffee and sandwiches, relaxed and waited for our tour guide at the arrivals/exit area.

Chris Heerey, our tour guide, was in constant communication with us before our scheduled time (3 a.m.). We started our tour visiting various locations, including some that we specifically requested beforehand (Sherlock Holmes’ museum, for example). Nighttime London was sleepy and dark. As morning started to enter the city, streets and businesses started to wake up slowly and rather hesitantly. Traffic did not become a concern up until 8 a.m. That is when huge lorries started to compete with the rest of the traffic. The overall contrast of the dark and mysterious nighttime London and its morning chaos was mesmerizing to witness.

Chris was absolutely amazing – he accommodated all our requests, kept us safe and sound, and even conducted extra research beforehand to insure that we had the best experience possible. I cannot find anything to suggest or improve as our tour was simply PERFECT!

We would like to thank Rob Woodford for doing such an amazing job in arranging our tour and Chris Heerey for providing us with the BEST experience possible!

It was nice because having a private tour allowed for a more personalized experience (getting to go into Twinings Tea, etc.) We left with a handful of recommendations for the rest of our time there. He was on time at our Hotel, very good introduction of the most important historical spots on the City. Drive excellent, he was kind and friendly all the time, ...Also give us good advise for later activities on London, Highly recommended!

We took the London Highlights Tour with Graham this past week- what an amazing way to see London! Graham was a fabulous tour guide- he took our family to so many places. I have two teen boys that were tired from traveling (London was our last Europe stop, after Italy and Spain), so they were burned out on sightseeing- but they loved Graham’s tour - he is so knowledgeable about London and its history and he has a great sense of humor. I highly highly recommend touring London with him- it was the best part of our 3 day London trip!

We had a 6 hour layover in London and we decided to squeeze in the 3 hour tour and it was perfect. Mark was an amazing driver and we were able to hit all the important landmarks, as well as some hidden ones we would never see exploring London without him. Incredibly knowledgeable about the city and provided great stories in addition to seeing the sites. Couldn't have asked for a better experience, and I would highly recommend to anyone who wants to see London and find out more about the city.

We booked a trip with Black Cab Heritage Tours and we couldn't have asked for a better driver. We had a wheel chair and he was incredibly accommodating and knowledgeable for our tour. It was a fantastic 4 hours and if there were more stars available I would have given more. Thank you Paul, you made our tour amazing.

We went on a day tour of London today and it was incredible! From the beginning Rob was great to deal with and answered all of my questions. Then today, our tour guide Sam was THE BEST! He made the day a huge success, showing us all of the amazing landmarks, sharing the incredible history that London has, and taking us off the beaten path to show us some of the hidden gems that the city has to offer. We cannot recommend this tour enough! Thank you Rob & Sam!!!

Sam was punctual and courteous. He was able to adjust his descriptions to us, the parents, and our 10 year old daughter. We repeatedly went off the beaten path and saw not only the standards, but also some hidden gems. This was a delight all around. Highly recommend.

Our tour guide Sam was a true gem! He took us to everything we wanted to see. Changing of the guards (he had a bonus for us...the Queens parade.) to Harry Potter to all of London's beautiful sites.

Sam was so personable...we couldn't have asked for a better guide. We had an awesome day!!! I would definitely recommend this tour. Our girls had an amazing experience.

I had read the great reviews of taking a black cab tour. And after completing our tour, I know why everyone raves about the tour. We had Paul as our driver (ask for Paul), for our first Black cab tour. Paul gave us a great ride and a walk around things we had not seen before. This was our third trip to London. Paul personalized the tour on the fly (so to speak), he was a gracious host and tour guide. Knowledgeable (without being boring), and fun to be with. My wife and I both felt that we had been shown the real London by an old friend. We cannot thank Paul enough. Highest recommendation.

This was an excellent way to see and learn a lot of London in half a day. Our guide did an exceptional job and we saw and learned so much more in a short time than we would have in a large tour setting. If you are short on time and want to see a lot I would highly recommend this tour.

Our Black Cab Heritage Tour with Craig was excellent. We arrived in London in the morning and had the tour that first afternoon. It was a great way to have an overview of the city and see so many sights in a four hour period. We now know where we want to go back and spend some additional time. I definitely recommend this tour company for a knowledgeable and well planned tour of London.
My family of 6 adults really enjoyed our 4 hour tour. We saw it all and learned so much. Great guide who tailored the tour to our interests.

Black Cab Heritage Tours had been recommended to us by a similar company that was fully booked the day we were in London - it as a great recommendation. Rob, the owner was quick to respond to emails and sent all the pre-tour information we needed well in advance.

Steve, the driver/guide, had been in touch the day before our tour to let us know that because President Trump was in town, we'd have to skip parts of the usual routes due to road closures. He promised us other sites of interest - and certainly delivered - including making a couple of diversions to see places we wanted to see that aren't on the tour route (such as the house I lived in as a student in London).

Our group, my family, has a mix of experience in London - I lived here for a few years, my wife has visited a few times and our teenaged daughters haven't been here since they were small and didn't remember much. Steve did a fantastic job of catering to all of us. We all enjoyed the tour and got some new knowledge out of it.

As to tips for enjoying the tour - it seems the drivers are pretty flexible to your wishes - we got out of the taxi to walk a few times - with Steve providing excellent guidance. If you're up for this, bring shoes that are ok for walking and coats/sweaters if its a cold or wet day. For some of the sights, you get a much better view and perspective getting out.

Would really recommend this as a way too see a lot of London in a short time. If you're on a longer trip, do this in the first couple of days to see where you want to go back and spend more time. Steve and Rob were both really friendly, punctual and helpful.

Our group of four adults arrived in London on the EuroStar train from Paris for a full day tour with Mark. He met us at the London St Pancras Train Station and took us to all the highlights of London in his black London taxi. He worked in our special requests to see Lloyds of London, Harrods and have fish and chips for lunch! Mark was professional, full of information about London and by the end of the tour he seemed like family!

Paul Williams took my Mom (who is disabled) and I around London and it was amazing. Even though my Mom could not get around well, Paul made sure we saw everything and up close! His knowledge was spot on and I recommend Paul 100%.

We visited many iconic London sights with Graham, who was knowledgeable and entertaining. The pace, variations for walking and driving, and opportunities for great photos were really appreciated. This is a fabulous way to see the city in comfort and with a local expert. Highly recommended!

My husband and I spent an afternoon touring London with Mark Kelly. What a wonderful way to see London without navigating on our own. Mark was informative, full of facts, and very fun. I was surprised at how many stops we made and the ability to look around a bit. I would highly recommend this tour.

The tour was magical! Our friendly taxi driver/tour host Barry was most knowledgeable and made our three hour tour a wonderful, educational, interesting and fun experience. Would not hesitate to recommend to friends and family. Definitely a 10/10 way to spend an afternoon.

If looking for a personalized way to see the sights of London, look no further. The three-hour tour we had provided new angles to London, including eg. visits to Harry Potter filming locations. Tailored to our family's needs, including planning the tour so that the drop-off at a requested location. Highly recommended.

We had a wonderful trip with Paul! The trip was excellent. Thank you very much!
We got to see a lot and Paul had a lot of knowledge about London.

We took a 2 hour tour last week with Ray. He was an awesome tour guide. He took us to all of the major sites in London as well as some hidden gems we wouldn't otherwise see - Winston Churchill's cigar bar for example. Since he also does tours on Harry Potter and Downton Abbey, we saw many sites relating to those as well. We couldn't have asked for a better into to London for my husband and I and our 3 kids.

We took a 4 hour tour with our driver guide Chris Heerey the day we landed in London. Chris picked us up at the airport, took us into central London and gave us an outstanding driving tour of many of London's highlights. It was a great thing to do on our first day, since we could get a flavor of things we wanted to come back to and we didn't have to worry about stashing our luggage before we could check in our flat. He made several stops along the way and walked us around the key viewing areas during the changing of the guard at Buckingham. He even took us to a nice place to pick up our groceries before we checked into our flat. Chris was very knowledgeable about many interesting facts about London and we felt like we had made a new friend by the end of our tour. He was a true gentleman and we would highly recommend Chris Heerey.

5 ⭐️rating for our Tour Guide Paul! We arrived in London from the USA at 7:30 AM and thought a 4 hour tour of the city would be a great way to get acclimated even though we were tired. Paul promptly gathered us at 1pm prepared with waters a smile and an expansive knowledge of British history! He made sure to take an extra lap as the sun had set and the Christmas lights were spectacular!

Barry took me and my family around for a 4-hour tour of London. We could not have been happier with his impressive knowledge of the city and its history, the interesting stories he told and how he even sang us a few English songs! The tour taught us all so much about London. We enjoyed the tour so much that we even decided to book Barry for a second evening to see more of the best pubs and restaurants in the city. Both tours were extremely educational and of course super fun and memorable. Highly recommend! Thanks a lot!
